description: Lint feedback after every edit and shell command, and the dmypy daemon's lifecycle (docs/features/static-analysis-20261031/spec.md, S06 and S08). Codex runs hook commands through the session's shell, which on Windows is always PowerShell (started with -NoProfile), so commandWindows is a bare program call with forward slashes, valid in PowerShell, zsh and bash, then `exit $LASTEXITCODE`: PowerShell -Command otherwise reports any failing program as exit 1, and Codex feeds findings back only on exit 2 (in zsh and bash the variable is unset, so `exit` returns the program's own status). It assumes the session starts at the repository root and that .venv exists (scripts/setup_worktree.py makes it).

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -S scripts/agent_lint_gate.py session-start; fi; exec uv run --no-project python scripts/agent_lint_gate.py session-start
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -S scripts/agent_lint_gate.py edit; fi; exec uv run --no-project python scripts/agent_lint_gate.py edit

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -S scripts/agent_lint_gate.py session-end; fi; exec uv run --no-project python scripts/agent_lint_gate.py session-end
